scenario.title: Decompose, amend and integrate structured work
situations: An Epic needs independent implementation lanes and integration proof.
A generated task must be split, moved or changed after planning.
Planning or integration simulation finds a gap.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Audit the graph amendment and simulator handoff procedure rather than treating 29 workflow-item commands as separate user features.

lessons.title: Let the structured plan own its generated tasks
lessons.when: When a selected workflow needs real task decomposition or its planned task graph changes.
lessons.need: Distinguish the parent item from generated tasks, persisted task scope, dispatch order, review and integration simulation; do not replace these with invented child items.
lessons.surface: Shepherd/Conduct/Amend/Simulate skills; workflow-item and epic-task operations
lessons.gap: Workflow-kind choice is mapped; post-planning amendment and integration-gap discovery are not. Review question: should the human see this depth only when their work actually requires multiple lanes or an amendment?
